Enquiries into this case have been
continued by C.I.D. (C.I.) in an effort to apprehend
or learn something regarding the persons responsible
for this crime. To date, these have not met with success.
As far as can be learned, those persons,
friends and acquaintances of complainant, present at
the time of the shooting have not returned to Shanghai
hence nothing further from that source can be learned
at present.

There is no definite proof to hand that
the crime was of a political nature and not one the
result of a grudge borne by an acquaintance (s) of
complainant.

Pending later and more useful information
on which investigations might be pursued, this file is
submitted for classification and filing.

A Final Report is attached.

at different times.

Doo Z Gee also a native of Yang Chung connected with

The following is the statement of **〔此处转录不清〕** Zien ( **〔此处转录不清〕** ) , age 37 .
native of **〔此处转录不清〕** taken by **〔此处转录不清〕** Dazala Zia Coen Zien
at Louza **〔此处转录不清〕** on the 7-6-39 and translated / interpreted by clerk Sin Yu Pala .

I reside at No.49, Kiukiang Road. I am employed
as tea-boy No.26 at the An Tung Lodging House, 131 Nanking Rd.
At about 7.30 a.m. to-day ( 7-6-39 ) I, being on
night duty, received a telephone call ( downstairs ) from
one named **〔此处转录不清〕** of the Great China Hotel, requesting the
occupant of Room 112 of the lodging house named Zung to answer.
I at once went to Room 112 and knocking on the door asked
the occupant to open. About 5 minutes later the man Zung
opened the door when I passed him the telephone message.
He went to use telephone but found the line disconnected. He returned
to his room, leaving the door ajar. I went to Room 117, and
about 5 minutes later, when I intended to wash my face I
suddenly heard the sound of 4 gun shots. I walked to Room
112 when I saw two men running out of the room, they stating
that they had "shot a Chinese editor/s". These two persons
made their way out of the back door, and decamped to an
unknown direction, their description being:
(1) Age about 30, height about 5'6", slim build,
wearing white foreign style clothing, speaking
Shanghai dialect. Pale face.
(2) Age about 27/8, height about 5'6", slim build,
pale face, wearing light grey 'Paris' cloth long
gown.

One occupant of Room 112, receiving injuries at
his hand, walked out of the room and requested to be taken
to hospital for treatment, whereupon I reported to the
Accountant Office, subsequently the Police being informed.

The following is the statement of Koo Ming ( ) alias Koo Tien Kee, 44,
native of Chinkiang taken by A. J. D. C. 7. Huang Shih Fu
at Hospital on the 9- -30 and interpreted by translated clerk Sh Yun Pai.

I am a cocoon dealer. On the 8th inst. I came
to Shanghai from Chinkiang by train. On arrival at this
port I resided in room 419 of the Lau Un Faung Lodging
House, Hankow road, later on the 28- -30 removing to Room
108 of the Au Lun Lodging House, 131 Nopoh Road. In taking
the present trip I was accompanied by four other persons,
viz: Koh Ping Kwang, Shu Lee Poo, Yuan Hai Yeu and Sung
Ai Deung. We five lived together.

In April last year, I had once visited Shanghai
when I resided at the Great China Hotel for about one month.
I had no trouble while remaining in Shanghai.

Unexpectedly, the shooting affray occurred this
morning. At about 6 or 7 a.m. I got up from bed to relieve
nature but about 5 minutes after I returned to bed I saw
a youth wearing foreign style white shirt and pants, age about
30, pale face, long hair brushed back, entering the room,
taking a black pistol in his hand. He opened fire at me,
he firing 4 shots altogether. I received injuries but my
co-inmate Shu Lee Poo was shot dead.

Between February, 1938 and June, 1938, I was the
principal of the Peace Maintenance Society at Tang Chung
Hsien.

There was nothing political regarding my present
visit to Shanghai. I do not know the reason why should I be
victimised.

True statement.

Signed and cross-marked.

我是一名蚕茧商人。本月8日，我乘火车从镇江来到上海。抵达本埠后，我住在汉口路老润丰旅馆（Lau Un Faung Lodging House）419号房间，随后于[日期不清]30日28日搬至北河南路（Nopoh Road）131号安伦旅馆（Au Lun Lodging House）108号房间。此次出行，另有四人同行，即：葛平光（Koh Ping Kwang）、徐礼甫（Shu Lee Poo）、袁海友（Yuan Hai Yeu）和宋爱登（Sung Ai Deung）。我们五人同住一处。

去年四月，我曾到过上海，在大中华酒店（Great China Hotel）居住约一个月。我在上海逗留期间未遇麻烦。

不料今晨发生枪击事件。早上约6或7点钟，我起床如厕，但回到床上约5分钟后，我看见一名身穿西式白衬衫和白裤的青年进入房间，年龄约30岁，面色苍白，长发向后梳理，手中持有一把黑色手枪。他向我开枪，共发射4发子弹。我受伤，而同住的徐礼甫（Shu Lee Poo）中弹身亡。

1938年2月至1938年6月期间，我曾担任扬中县（Tang Chung Hsien）治安维持会会长。

我此次来沪没有任何政治目的。我不知道为何会成为受害者。

供词属实。

On 25-6-39, I together with Shu Se Pro, a rice dealer, Foo Sien Tse, a man about 44, native of Yang Chung Hsien, the former chairman of Chamber of Commerce, Yang Chung Hsien, and the present Magistrate of that Hsien, appointed by the Reformed Government, and Yuan Pai Tsu (Shu Se Pro's friend), the manager of the Mei Ping Transportation Company (Japanese concern) in Shanghai, came to Shanghai by train. Last night (26-6-39) there were six persons in the room altogether, Shu Se Pro and Foo Sien Tse occupying one of the beds; I and Mr. Diem taking another bed, while Hsu Zung Zei and Dong Zeng Nyeu lying on a sofa.

Zung Ai Daung got up, going out for the phone but returned to the room a few minutes later, he stating that someone was making a joke, the line being disconnected. However all men paid no attention to the matter.

asked Tong in which room Yuan Hei Tsu resided, but he replied
he did not know.
Returning to Room 122 I found many persons present.
I do not know who had shot dead Shu Pse Foo.
Later I was brought to the Station for enquiries.

The following is the statement of Daung Zang Nyou ( ), age 45,
native of Yan Chung Hsien taken by Mr. D.I. Loh Kung Sung
at Louza Stn. on the 27-5-39 and translated by Clerk Sin Yun Pai.

I am the proprietor of the Hun Shin Cloth Shop
at Shin Loong Town, Yan Chung Hsien.
Now I am temporarily living at No.18 Sung Bing Lee,
Rue du Weikwei, French Concession, the home of my relative
Mon Nyosh Liang.

I came to Shanghai on the 3rd of May for the purpose
of sending my son Daung Kyi Pon, age 17, to the Sung Foh Kyi
Glass Factory, Avenue Edward VII, opposite the Chung Wei
Building, to be employed as an apprentice. I was waiting for
some fellow countrymen who intended to return to the country,
so that we could take the journey together.

At about 2.p.m. on 25-5-39, while walking on Avenue
Edward VII I encountered my fellow countryman Shu Tse Foo.
He told me that he was living in Room 122 of the An Tung
Lodging house, later we separating.

At about 8.p.m. yesterday (26-5-39) I attended
Room 122 of the above lodging house when I found that all
the occupants were my fellow countrymen, they being: Shu Tse
Foo (now deceased), Koo Tien Ming (wounded), Zung Ai Daung,
Koh Ping Kwung and Han Zung Zai. They discussed re silk
cocoons, I took no part in same.

Owing to curfew order I remained in the room, occupy-
ing a sofa with Han Zung Zai for the night. Shu Tse Foo and
Koo Tien Ming slept on a large bed, while Zung Ai Daung and
Koh Ping Kwung occupied a small bed.

At about 7.a.m. this morning, I was suddenly waken
up by the sound "Pa" "Pa", about 4 shots being fired.

以下为本人 D.I. 罗公松（Loh Kung Sung，音译）先生于1939年5月27日在老闸捕房对籍贯为盐城县的唐章牛（Daung Zang Nyou，音译），45岁，所作的供词记录，由书记员辛云白（Sin Yun Pai，音译）翻译。

我是盐城县新龙镇恒信布庄的店主。
目前我暂住在法租界维格威路（Rue du Weikwei，音译）宋炳礼（Sung Bing Lee，音译）18号，这是我亲戚莫耀良（Mon Nyosh Liang，音译）的家。

我于5月3日来上海，目的是送我的儿子唐基邦（Daung Kyi Pon，音译），17岁，到爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）中汇大楼对面的松福记玻璃厂当学徒。我在等待几位打算回乡的同乡，以便结伴同行。

1939年5月25日下午2点左右，我在爱多亚路行走时遇到了我的同乡舒子富（Shu Tse Foo，音译）。他告诉我他住在安东旅馆122号房间，随后我们便分开了。

昨天（1939年5月26日）晚上8点左右，我去了上述旅馆的122号房间，发现里面的住客都是我的同乡，他们是：舒子富（现已去世）、顾天明（Koo Tien Ming，音译，受伤）、钟爱东（Zung Ai Daung，音译）、柯平光（Koh Ping Kwung，音译）和韩宗载（Han Zung Zai，音译）。他们在讨论生丝蚕茧的事，我没有参与。

由于宵禁令，我留在房间里，当晚和韩宗载共用一张沙发。舒子富和顾天明睡在一张大床上，而钟爱东和柯平光睡在一张小床上。

今天早上7点左右，我突然被“啪”、“啪”的声音惊醒，大约开了4枪。

The following is the statement of Mr Aung ai ( ), age 39 years.
native of Yang Tsoong taken by me C. D. C. 341
at Louza Station on the 27-5-30 and translated by Clerk Tang

I am married but unemployed.
On 13th day of May this year I came to Shanghai by Vai
Lee Steam Launch for selling a number of chickens which I
brought from home with me and I resided in Room 40, Wu Sing
Lodging House, and 379, House No.51, Soochow Road for ten
days. At about 6 p.m. on 25-5-30 I met two countrymen
named Koo Sion Te and Toh Ping Wen in front of the Dah Faung
Lodging House at Rue Tourane in French Concession and I asked
them where were they living and when did they come.
I was told by Koo Sion Te that they came to Shanghai
several days ago and they are residing in Room 122, Lu Tung
Hotel, 131 Hupeh Road. I therefore visited them in Room 122,
Lu Tung Hotel at 8 p.m. last night.
After having had a long conversation, I was unable to leave
the hotel owing to the curfew hour.
I and Daung Jang Nyou went to one bed and Hsu Tse Foo
together with Koo Sion Te had one bed while Zung Ai Dong and
Toh Ping Wen passed the night on a sofa.
Nothing happened on the night until 7 a.m. today when I
was roused by four reports of gun-shots and I dared not
to look but I waited and got up and dressed myself until I
hear no more noise in the room when I saw Hsu Tse Foo lying
dead at the side of a cupboard and Koo Sion Te sitting on the
bed wounded. After a short while Hsu and Koo were removed
to hospital by ambulance. I had almost a shock and I do not
know what they have been doing or by whom they were shot.
This is my true statement.

Signed Mr Aung ai

以下为本人 C. D. C. 341 于1930年5月27日（原文如此，应为1939年）在老闸捕房对籍贯为杨总（Yang Tsoong，音译）的昂爱（Mr Aung ai，音译）先生，39岁，所作的供词记录，由书记员唐（Tang，音译）翻译。

我已婚，但失业。
今年5月13日，我乘坐威利轮船（Vai Lee Steam Launch，音译）来上海，出售我从家乡带来的一批鸡，我在苏州路51号379弄武胜旅馆40号房间住了十天。1930年5月25日（原文如此，应为1939年）下午6点左右，我在法租界图兰路（Rue Tourane，音译）的大方旅馆前遇到了两位同乡，名叫顾先德（Koo Sion Te，音译）和陶平文（Toh Ping Wen，音译），我问他们住在哪里以及何时来的。
顾先德告诉我，他们几天前来上海，住在湖北路131号鲁通旅馆122号房间。因此，我昨晚8点去鲁通旅馆122号房间拜访了他们。
长谈之后，由于宵禁时间已到，我无法离开旅馆。
我和唐章牛（Daung Jang Nyou，音译）睡在一张床上，徐子富（Hsu Tse Foo）和顾先德睡在一张床上，而钟爱东（Zung Ai Dong，音译）和陶平文在沙发上过夜。
当晚无事，直到今天早上7点，我被四声枪响惊醒，我不敢看，只是等着，起身穿好衣服，直到房间里不再有声响，我才看见徐子富死在一个柜子旁边，顾先德坐在床上受了伤。过了一会儿，徐和顾被救护车送往医院。我深受惊吓，不知道他们在做什么，也不知道是谁开枪射击了他们。
这是我的真实供词。

昂爱（Mr Aung ai）先生签名

The following is the statement of Zung Yoong Tsing ( ), age 41,
native of Yangchow taken by n/o C.D.S.196 Dao Zu Pih
at Louza Stn. on the 27-5-39 and translated / verified by Clerk Sih Yun Pai.

I am the proprietor of the Vai Loong Tsong Cloth
Shop, situated at Pah Z Jau Town, Yang Chun Hsien.

On 24-5-39, I left Pah Z Jau Town and arrived at
Shanghai at about 4.30p.m. 25-5-39. Upon arrival at this
port I lived at the Lih Yane Shoe Store, located inside
the Continental Emporium, Nankin Road, the manager of which
shop Wong Vai Doon being my relative. Later, at 9.a.m.
on 26-5-39, I removed to Room 11 of the Sing Hwa Lodging
House, Lane 112, no.3 Fokien Road.

My visit to Shanghai this time was to buy a quantity
of white cloth, arrangements for this purchase having been
made with Lieu Tse Ziang of the Ten Woo Cloth Hong, Tse
Foo Lee off Fokien Road, on two previous occasions.

This morning at about 7.30 a.m. a fellow country-
man Han Zung Zai of mine called on me at my room and informed me of the
assassination of Zung Ai Daung at the An Tung Lodging House.

As Zung Ai Daung was also a fellow countryman, I
proceeded to the An Tung Lodging House when I found that the
man who had been shot dead was not Zung Ai Daung but a man
named Shu Tse Foo. Koo Sien Tse, my fellow countryman, was
also wounded. I do not know Shu Tse Foo before.

When I attended the room, detectives were making
investigations, afterwards I being taken to the Station for
enquiries.

True statement.

Signed and cross-marked:
Zung Yoong Tsing.

警务调查报告。

以下为本人 C.D.S.196 道祖毕（Dao Zu Pih，音译）于1939年5月27日在老闸捕房对籍贯为扬州的钟永清（Zung Yoong Tsing，音译），41岁，所作的供词记录，由书记员施云白（Sih Yun Pai，音译）翻译/核实。

我是位于扬春县帕兹焦镇（Pah Z Jau Town，音译）的威隆总布庄的店主。

1939年5月24日，我离开帕兹焦镇，于1939年5月25日下午4点30分左右抵达上海。抵达此地后，我住在南京路大陆商场内的利严鞋店，该店经理黄伟敦（Wong Vai Doon，音译）是我的亲戚。后来，在1939年5月26日上午9点，我搬到了福建路3号112弄兴华旅馆11号房间。

我这次来上海是为了购买一批白布，此前我曾两次与福建路子富里（Tse Foo Lee，音译）的天吴布行（Ten Woo Cloth Hong，音译）的刘子祥（Lieu Tse Ziang，音译）安排了此次购买事宜。

今天早上7点30分左右，我的同乡韩宗载来到我的房间，告知我钟爱东在安东旅馆被刺杀的消息。

由于钟爱东也是同乡，我前往安东旅馆，发现被枪杀的人不是钟爱东，而是一个名叫舒子富的人。我的同乡顾先泽（Koo Sien Tse，音译）也受了伤。我以前不认识舒子富。

当我到达房间时，侦探正在进行调查，随后我被带到捕房接受询问。

属实。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,

MAY 28 1939

Assassins Kill
Dealer; Injure
"Magistrate"

Shooting in Hupeh
Road Hotel

Shu Ts-fu, 56 year-old silk cocoon
dealer, was killed and Ku Ming, 44
year-old recently appointed chair-
man of the Yangchun Shen, situated
East of Yangchow, was seriously
wounded and is at present being
treated in a local hospital following
the attempt made by two assassins
shortly after 7.30 a.m. yesterday, to
shoot the official in his room at the
Antung Hotel, 131 Hupeh Road. Three
other residents of Chinkiang who
were in the hotel room at the time
of the shooting were being questioned
by Louza station and Crime Branch
Headquarter detectives yesterday, but
will not be detained, according to
information made available late last
night. Japanese military police
officials visited the scene of the shoot-
ing yesterday morning and com-
menced investigating the assassination
on their own.

The five persons, all natives of
Chinkiang, were in room 122 of the
Antung Hotel, when shortly after 7.30
a.m. a foreign-style dressed Chinese,
about 30 years old, opened the door
and brandishing a pistol, fired four
shots, presumably with the intention
of killing Ku. The occupants of the
room, threw themselves on the floor
in an effort to evade being shot, but
Shu had already been killed by a
single shot which had pierced the
lower part of his body, whilst two
of the assassin's bullets found a mark
in Ku, one bullet piercing his body
and another smashing his right arm.

Cocoon Deal

Detectives from Louza police station
were immediately summoned and ac-
cording to the statements of the other
cocoon dealers in the room, the five
persons were about to conclude a
contract for the purchase of a large
quantity of cocoons. A contract
which however had not yet been
signed, was found on the table in the
room and thus substantiates the
statement. The dead man, as far as
could be ascertained, had no political
connections and was merely eager to
buy cocoons.

All those in the room had first
arrived in Shanghai on May 20, and
had lived in various hotels since
their arrival. On Friday evening,
they booked room 122 in the Antung
Hotel, in order to conclude the con-
tract in question which had obviously
been the main reason for their pre-
sence in Shanghai.

The weapon used in the shooting—
a .32 calibre automatic pistol—has not
been identified as far as could be
ascertained, and with the exception
of four cartridge cases found in the
room and the hall, no further evidence
was discovered on the scene. Ac-
cording to unconfirmed reports, the
assassin after the deed, threatened a
hotel employee with his pistol, prior
to decamping with his unarmed ac-
complice, and told him that he had
"merely exterminated another
traitor."

Whilst Ku's condition was stated
as being serious, it was learned that
attending physicians expected him to
live.

1939年5月28日

刺客杀死
商人；伤及
“县长”

湖北路旅馆发生枪击案

56岁的蚕茧商人舒子富（Shu Ts-fu）被杀，44岁、最近被任命为位于扬州以东的阳春绅（Yangchun Shen，音译，疑指某种地方职务或机构）主席的顾明（Ku Ming，音译）受重伤，目前正在当地医院接受治疗。此事源于昨天上午7点30分过后不久，两名刺客试图在湖北路131号安东旅馆的房间内枪杀这位官员。据昨晚深夜获得的消息，当时在旅馆房间内的另外三名镇江居民正接受老闸捕房和刑事科总部侦探的讯问，但不会被拘留。日本宪兵官员昨天上午参观了枪击现场，并开始自行调查这起刺杀案。

这五个人都是镇江人，当时正在安东旅馆122号房间内。上午7点30分过后不久，一名身穿西式服装、约30岁的中国男子打开门，挥舞着手枪，开了四枪，推测意图是杀死顾某。房间内的住客纷纷扑倒在地，以躲避枪击，但舒某已被一枪击中下身当场死亡，而刺客的两颗子弹击中了顾某，一颗穿透其身体，另一颗打碎了他的右臂。

蚕茧交易

老闸捕房的侦探立即被召至现场，根据房间内其他蚕茧商人的陈述，这五人正准备签订一份购买大量蚕茧的合同。桌上发现了一份尚未签署的合同，从而证实了这一说法。据查，死者没有任何政治背景，只是急于购买蚕茧。

房间内的所有人都是于5月20日首次抵达上海，此后一直住在各家旅馆。周五晚上，他们在安东旅馆预订了122号房间，以便签订这份合同，这显然也是他们来上海的主要原因。

据查，枪击中使用的武器——一支.32口径自动手枪——尚未被识别，除了在房间和走廊发现的四个弹壳外，现场未发现其他证据。据未经证实的消息称，刺客在作案后用手枪威胁了一名旅馆员工，并在与其手无寸铁的同伴逃跑前告诉他，自己只是“消灭了另一个汉奸”。

虽然顾某的病情被描述为严重，但据悉主治医生预计他能存活。
